exposure: pulmonary embolism (PE) risk classification (low, intermediate, high)
outcome: VTE manifestations (isolated DVT, isolated PE, combined DVT/PE, upper limb DVT)
cohort: The study included 330 patient admissions related to VTE, with 303 acute VTE episodes, presenting to a tertiary care hospital in India between January 2017 and January 2020.
finding: The study found that active malignancy and high-risk pulmonary embolism were independent predictors of in-hospital mortality among patients presenting with acute venous thromboembolism.
